head: cd235cadf287e51d81537933e9a0e557b3f92acc
summary:
The code matches the design. The only departures are the ones the build declared, and the listing failpoint sits where the design needs it. In DirectoryReader.List (DirectoryReader.cs:109-124), SynchronousIoCancel.ListingError swaps the error right after io.Query returns and before the `error != 0` check. It replaces only a call that returned a page, and LastCallAborted stays false on that call, so the pages already read are kept and Scanner.FolderDone (Scanner.cs:275-285) adds the children and then sets Unreadable, unchanged. Page is a local counter per listing. The name match takes the leaf after the last '\\', which agrees with how LongPath.Child builds paths. The root is listed through the path-less public List overload, so it is never faulted.

I re-ran everything myself rather than trusting the build's account:
- Core.Tests: 414/414 passed.
- Fitness: 63 rules hold.
- rules-parity: AGREE.
- T-007 passed: P kept 355 of 2,000 and reads 'could not be read in full'; Q is read in full; R reads 'could not be opened'; root = 9,646,080.
- T-008 passed: 4 bad values, each exiting 0xE0434352 with no report.
- The full `WindowCases.ps1 -Case All` passed: 48 cases, EXIT 0; N-001..N-004 not run.
- Mutant ListingFailsAnyFolder: T-007 failed on Q and on the failpoint firing twice.
- Mutant NoFailListingMember: T-007 failed on its first check with MissingMethodException.

The mutants run in a scratch copy, so the tree was not touched. Every matrix shape is fed by the named test. The two mutants have to be named when running WindowMutants.ps1; `-Case All` does not run them.

One minor gap: T-008 does not feed the empty-name refusal. The design contract lists that case, and the build's own extra refusals (a path separator, error 18, a non-numeric error) are not fed either.

The bug report was only a title. I assumed what the build check and the design agreed on: the Core scanner-level test already exists (it was cut from the slice), and only the window case and the seam it needs are owed.

Second round: This second pass tried to break the changed code and found nothing new beyond first round's m1, which still stands.

- **The hook's value parser** (StartupHook.cs ArmFailListing) handles every awkward input loudly. Numbers are parsed with NumberStyles.None and the invariant culture, so a trailing CR/LF, whitespace, a '+' or '-' sign, an empty part, a non-ASCII digit or an int overflow each fails with FormatException. That is a logged refusal, and the app ends. '|' cannot appear in a Windows file name, so splitting on it is safe. A name with stray whitespace arms for a folder that does not exist and never fires. The design contract says the case must catch that itself, and T-007 does, with its own 'fired' check.
- **The leaf matcher** (ListingError) behaves correctly at every edge I found:
  - A path with no '\\' gives LastIndexOf -1, +1 = 0, so the whole string is compared.
  - Scanner's child paths come from LongPath.Child and never end in '\\'.
  - The root reaches List through the overload with no path.
- **Refused error values:** ClassifyReadError (Scanner.cs:54-57) treats every non-zero error as Unreadable, except 995 while a cancel is requested. In DirectoryReader, only 18, and 2 on the first page, end a listing as complete. So refusing 0 and 18 is the complete set.
- **Racing a cancel:** Query settles an issued cancel to Aborted (SynchronousIoCancel.cs:278-296). The failpoint, which acts only on a call that returned 0, therefore never races a cancel.
- **Type load before Main:** reflection now loads SynchronousIoCancel before the app's Main, which runs its static initializer (CheckedKeepLastAccessInfo) early. That is a pure layout check. If it threw, the hook would log a refusal, rather than the scan faulting later.
- **The fired callback** calls Log on the scan thread. Log swallows its own exceptions, so it cannot fault the scan.
- **T-007's log reads:** Invoke-WithHook builds Log as @(Get-Content …), which never holds a $null, so the StartsWith filters cannot throw.
- **The mutant's find pattern** matches under both LF and CRLF checkouts, and Set-Mutation refuses anything but exactly one match.
- **Doc comment references:** a --no-incremental Release build of Core gives 0 warnings, so the ambiguous `<see cref="List"/>` is not flagged (Core generates no documentation file).

findings.claim: The code refuses more bad values than T-008 feeds it, including the one the design contract names. The contract's error_cases for FailListingOf say 'Empty name throws'. SynchronousIoCancel.FailListingOf (SynchronousIoCancel.cs:146-150) also refuses a name with a path separator and win32Error 18. ArmFailListing (StartupHook.cs:245-248) also refuses a non-numeric error. T-008's $bad table feeds only four values: two parts, non-numeric page, page 1, and error 0. The error-18 refusal exists because 18 would make DirectoryReader.List return 0 (DirectoryReader.cs:115-116). P would then be truncated and look complete, with no Unreadable flag. A regression in any of these four refusals goes unnoticed. The empty-name and separator refusals would still leave a case's own 'fired' check to catch it. The error-18 regression would leave P listed partway with no note, and nothing would flag it as a failpoint problem.
findings.evidence: tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 Test-T008: $bad holds 'folder1|2', 'folder1|two|995', 'folder1|1|995', 'folder1|2|0' only. src/FsAnalyser.Core/Scanning/SynchronousIoCancel.cs:146-150 branches on IsNullOrWhiteSpace / IndexOfAny(['\\','/']) / ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES. tests/window/FsaWindowHook/StartupHook.cs:247-248 branches on a non-numeric error.
findings.fix: Add four rows to T-008's $bad table, each with its refusal regex: '|2|995' (ArgumentException, Parameter 'folderName'), 'a\\b|2|995' (ArgumentException), 'folder1|2|18' (ArgumentOutOfRangeException, Parameter 'win32Error'), and 'folder1|2|x' (FormatException 'the error ''x'' is not a whole number').

obligations.evidence: StartupHook.cs:213 calls ArmFailListing inside Initialize, before the hook thread and before Main. Test-T007 asserts that exactly one armed line exists and that it is log[0]. My T-007 run logged 'fail-listing armed p-… page 2 error 995' first, then 'loaded mode=tree'.

Test-T008 feeds the design's shapes: wrong part count, non-numeric page, page 1 (plus error 0). I re-ran it: all four exit -532462766, write no report, and log a single refusal line. The missing-member shape is the NoFailListingMember mutant in WindowMutants.ps1, which I ran: MissingMethodException, 0xE0434352, and T-007 failed on its first check. The contract's empty-name case is not fed (see m1).
New-PartwayTree writes 2,000 files named 'file-NNNN-<32hex>.bin' (46 chars, 184-byte records). My run logged 'fail-listing fired p-… page 2', and P kept 355 of 2,000.
T-007 asserts note 'could not be read in full', 0 < k < 2000, and size = onDisk = k × 4 KiB. It passed with k = 355.

Q is 'a-<tag>' with 2,000 files. Scanner.cs:287-296 pushes last-first, so Q is listed before P. T-007 asserts Q is read in full. I ran the ListingFailsAnyFolder mutant: it fired on a-… and p-…, and T-007 failed on Q's childCount of 355.

R is created empty and denied through Deny-Listing (icacls /deny RD). T-007 asserts note 'could not be opened', expander false, childCount 0 and onDisk 0, and undoes the deny in finally. My run passed.

T-007 runs with FSA_HOOK_WALK=2 and asserts rendered.expanded and nodeExpanded. It asserts 355 depth-2 children, each drawn by its own container, against a 284 px viewport. My run: walked 359, unrendered 0.
No schema-1 change was made; WindowReport.cs is untouched. I ran `WindowCases.ps1 -Case All`: PASSED for all 48 listed cases, EXIT 0, with N-001..N-004 not run.

This one is owed to validate-slice; this is my read of the code. At DirectoryReader.cs:109-112 the substitution runs right after io.Query and before the `error != 0` block at 113-124. The swapped call returned 0, so io.LastCallAborted is false and _count is not reset. Scanner.FolderDone (Scanner.cs:275-285) then adds the kept entries and sets Unreadable. T-007 measured 355 kept with the partial note.
The failpoint is static members on the existing SynchronousIoCancel (SynchronousIoCancel.cs:122-166), not a new class. The Fitness check says all 63 rules hold, and rules-parity reports AGREE.

Q has P's multi-page shape and sorts first. The ListingFailsAnyFolder mutant exists in WindowMutants.ps1, and I ran it: it passed, meaning T-007 failed exactly on the fired-once check and on the Q-in-full check.
T-007 uses the tree-row lines. It asserts P.size = k × 4 KiB, 0 < k < 2000, drawn children = k with k × 20 > viewport, root = P + Q, and the order Q, P, R.
T-007 asserts note, expander, childCount and size for the Q, P, R and root rows from the tree-row lines. WindowReport.cs is unchanged, as Q-016 requires.

The fixture is 2,000 files per folder. The fired callback goes through ListingError to the hook, which logs 'fail-listing fired <name> page <n>'. T-007 has its own check for a missing fired line and asserts k ≤ 1000.
T-008 is the bad-value case. The Disarm half was declined by the m7 disposition and is listed as not built.

The reworded invariant is in FailListingOf's doc comment at SynchronousIoCancel.cs:135-139. Enforcement is the src/** FSA_HOOK_ rule plus the new App rule in fitness.yaml, and the Fitness check passes.

cases.evidence:
T-007 sets FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING='

|2|995' for P, a folder in the fixture, and asserts the armed line is log[0], before 'loaded mode=tree'. Passed in my run.

T-008 launches separately with 'folder1|2' (arg count), 'folder1|two|995' (non-numeric page), 'folder1|1|995' (page<2) and 'folder1|2|0'. Each asserts 0xE0434352, no report, and a single refusal line. The member-not-found shape is fed by the NoFailListingMember mutant, which renames FailListingOf in a scratch copy; I ran it and it passed. That mutant runs only when named, not in -Case All.
P holds 2,000 files with 46-char names, about 355 per 64 KiB page, so six pages. The fault is armed at page 2 and T-007 asserts the 'fired … page 2' line. Measured: 355 kept.
T-007 asserts P's drawn note is 'could not be read in full' with 0 < childCount = 355 < 2000, which lands on FolderTreeNode's ChildCount>0 branch.
Q is 'a-<tag>', multi-page with 2,000 files, and listed before P. T-007 asserts no note and 2,000 children. The mutant with the name check removed makes T-007 fail on Q (verified by running it).
R is created empty and denied through Deny-Listing (icacls /deny RD), the existing ACL route. T-007 asserts 'could not be opened', no expander, and childCount 0.
FSA_HOOK_WALK=2 opens P through its container. T-007 asserts rendered.expanded, nodeExpanded, and 355 drawn children, more than the 284 px viewport holds.
I ran `WindowCases.ps1 -Case All`: all 48 listed cases passed, EXIT 0; N-001..N-004 not run (they need -IncludeNetwork). No schema-1 change was made.

Every non-hooked case in the All run launches the published exe without DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS. No product code references the variable or the method: the Fitness check holds for the src/** FSA_HOOK_ rule and for the new App rule over FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING and FailListingOf\(. The build also ran the published exe with the variable set and no hook, and it scanned all 2,000 files; I did not re-run that launch.

drift: I found no departure the build left undeclared. One narrowing is disclosed only as a follow-up, not labelled a deviation. The hook reads FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING only when FSA_HOOK_MODE is set and the process is FsAnalyser.App.exe (StartupHook.cs:197-200, 213). That is narrower than the contract's auth_model, 'Read only when DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS loads FsaWindowHook'. The hook header says 'any mode', which means any mode value, not no mode at all.

The failpoint fires for every folder with that leaf name anywhere in the tree, for the whole life of the process, rescans included. The root is never faulted (DirectoryReader.cs:94). Both are declared in FailListingOf's doc comment, and the design keyed the failpoint by leaf name, so a reader expecting 'one named folder' should know it means any folder of that name.
